answer: In agent economies, a concrete anti-Sybil defense locks a minimum stake of tokens per identity before any reward-eligible action. The mechanism works by requiring each account to deposit capital that remains locked during participation, so an attacker creating many fake agents must fund every one separately. This multiplies the attacker cost linearly with the number of sybils while a single honest agent pays only once. Imagine a protective dune of locked value rising against the zephyr of spam, built upon the jetty of verified deposits that prevent free identity multiplication.
